title: Declared script coverage fallback for ASS sidecar fonts
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: When AssFontLayoutPolicy.scriptCoverage is non-empty, ASS sidecar export resolves the written Style Fontname against declared script tags in the cue text (bounded Latn/Han/Hira/Kana/Hang/Arab/Hebr/Zsye, not a full UCD Script property). A Latin-only requested family is not written as if it covered CJK, emoji, or RTL: the first listed registered fallback that declares complete coverage is written, with ASS_FONT_COVERAGE_SUBSTITUTED:from->to:missingTags and ASS_LAYOUT_MAY_CHANGE. If no listed registered fallback declares complete coverage, export is ASS_FONT_COVERAGE_UNAVAILABLE rather than silently keeping the original family.

An empty coverage map keeps the Increment C.1 name-only fallback on this branch and invents no coverage warnings. encode without a policy remains ASS_EXPORT_FONT_POLICY_REQUIRED. A missing requested family remains ASS_FONT_UNAVAILABLE when no name fallback exists, and may also emit ASS_FONT_SUBSTITUTED to the final covering family when a later fallback supplies coverage. Import with a coverage policy lists the same substitute and still warns ASS_STYLE_FONT_NOT_RENDERED; it does not refuse the file. This is not deterministic shaping, bidi layout, glyph rendering, or lossless arbitrary ASS effects.

A workbench path adds a CJK/emoji/RTL cue, fills a declared coverage map (StudioTestSans:Latn and StudioTestNoto covering Latn,Han,Hebr,Arab,Zsye), and exports ASS so the sidecar and caption-export-status list the coverage substitute and do not write the Latin-only requested family. An SDK persist path also imports an Arabic ASS whose Style names the Latin-only family, confirms SetCaptions(automatic: true) is MANUAL_FIELD_LOCKED on a hand-edited cue, keeps CAPTION_OVERLAP, and keeps MP4 export CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Source-interval crop stays closed.

Already-delivered plain caption domain, split/trim/exact positive-rate map, manual ownership, overlap rejection, bounded SRT/VTT/static ASS import, SRT/VTT export, AssFontLayoutPolicy name fallback, cue versions/undo/reopen/archive/fork, clipLocal default, explicit source anchors, caption-aware editor commands, and field-aware invert stay unchanged. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP. I-005 and I-010 stay partial. This captions-side increment is C.2; Increment C.1 evidence remains in evidence/caption-ass-export, and mainline 1.66/1.67 remain invert slices.
